dataset.execution_fidelity: last OPRA NBBO quote per one-minute interval; intraminute ordering unavailable

audit.entry_execution: first eligible option quote after the completed signal bar; filled at ask
audit.excursion_measurement: Per-trade MAE and MFE use only chronological valid NBBO bids available from entry through the executed exit, including the entry quote when its bid is executable; they are bounded by the dataset quote resolution and are not an unobserved intraminute path. The path is censored at the trade's actual exit: an enabled stop loss can truncate the observed excursion
audit.execution_fidelity: last OPRA NBBO quote per one-minute interval; intraminute ordering unavailable
audit.exit_execution: first eligible option quote after the earliest exit trigger; filled at bid; detection is limited to the dataset quote resolution (1m)
audit.source_reference_format: filename:line=<source row ordinal>;sha256=<source file hash>; the ordinal is a physical line for CSV or a deterministic logical row for the checksummed Parquet partition
audit.stop_loss_sweep: Each listed loss threshold is a complete independent strategy replay against the same dataset and settings, changing only maximum-loss stop activation and percentage. Positions, exits, and later re-entries are recomputed for every threshold. Outcomes use the first eligible bid and remain bounded by the dataset quote resolution
audit.stop_loss_sweep_verification: The run command calculates and hashes every candidate replay. verify-result independently reruns the configured strategy, confirms its metrics and dataset fingerprint, and validates every candidate configuration and metrics hash without executing the full sweep a second time
audit.timestamps: ISO-8601 market-local timestamps with explicit UTC offsets; parallel UTC timestamps are recorded per trade

settings_flat.value: profit_target, stop_loss, opposite_macd, opposite_smi, advanced_metric, time_exit
